note: Brief 109 round 1 (Latch): moments 1-3 before (-juice off) and after (-juice on), each a short clip at play zoom on the route scripts' own orders. The Office front is played at yaw 210 (step 2). Run by briefs/109/latch/clips.ts, which launches the player twice and encodes each clip to mp4. A clip frame steps the game by its real frame time (about 27 ms), so clips.ts encodes each at the rate its ticks say (true speed).
